finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in twin pregnancies did not increase the risk of cesarean section but was associated with increased risk of some neonatal complications, including higher birth weight in the smaller twin and respiratory distress syndrome, intracranial bleeding, and preterm retinopathy in the larger twin.
mod_finding: While gestational diabetes in twin pregnancy did not increase the risk of cesarean section, it was associated with increased neonatal complications.
